```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

tsv_folder <- file.path(BE_MASTER, "2.intermediate/2.4.inference")
export_folder <- file.path(BE_MASTER, "3.integration/integration_project/spatial_analysis/tabular/merged")

collected_files_csv_path <- file.path(export_folder, "collected_files.csv")

# Function to process a single file
process_file <- function(single_file_path) {
  single_file <- read.delim(single_file_path)
  single_file$wsi <- substr(single_file$Image, 1, 5)
  wsi <- single_file$wsi[1]

  if (wsi %in% predictions$wsi) {
    single_file$flow <- sample_data$flow[as.character(sample_data$slide_id) == wsi]
    single_file$progression <- sample_data$progression[sample_data$slide_id == wsi]
    single_file$pred <- predictions$pred[predictions$wsi == wsi]
    return(single_file)
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

# Get the list of TSV files
tsv_files <- list.files(file.path(tsv_folder, "tsv_attn_cell_segment_250801"), full.names = TRUE)

# Process files using purrr's map_dfr
collected_files <- map_dfr(tsv_files, process_file)

# Ensure Class is a factor
collected_files$Class <- as.factor(collected_files$Class)


# Define factors
# NU_factor <- 0.4548
# MDA_factor <- 0.5013
# Join and mutate operations
collected_files <- collected_files %>%
  left_join(
    y=collected_files %>%
      select(Image, Name, attention_score) %>%
      distinct()%>%
      rename(Parent = Name, filled_score = attention_score),
    by = c("Image", "Parent")
  ) %>%
  mutate(attention_score = ifelse(is.na(attention_score), filled_score, attention_score)) %>%
  select(-filled_score) %>%
  right_join(
    sample_data_withFU %>%
      select(slide_id, Dataset) %>%
      rename(wsi = slide_id, dataset = Dataset),
    by = "wsi")

```

```{r clean up }
region_level <- collected_files%>%

  distinct(Object.ID, .keep_all = TRUE)%>%
  mutate(
    Class = as.character(Class),
    temp_name = ifelse(Class == "Region", Name, as.character(NA)),
    temp_parent = ifelse(Class == "Region", Parent, as.character(NA))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Name = ifelse(Class == "Region", temp_parent, Name),
    Parent = ifelse(Class == "Region", temp_name, Parent),
    Class = ifelse(Class == "Region", temp_parent, Class)) %>%
  select(-temp_name, -temp_parent, -Length.µm,-Num.points,-Perimeter.µm, -Name,-Object.ID,-ROI)%>%
  filter(!Class %in% c("background", "Image", "squamous_area"))%>%
  mutate(Class = as.factor(Class))%>%
  drop_na(attention_score)%>%
  relocate(c(wsi,flow,progression,pred,dataset), .after = Image)%>%
  group_by(Image, Parent) %>% #remove empty ones
  filter(sum(Num.Detections) != 0)  %>%
```

```{r attn_class}

attn_extend_neighbour <- function(df, tile_size = 112) {
  # Check if dataframe is empty
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(df)
  }
  
  # Extract coordinates from Parent column
  df$X <- as.numeric(sub("_.*", "", df$Parent))
  df$Y <- as.numeric(sub(".*_", "", df$Parent))
  
  # Check if coordinate extraction was successful
  if (any(is.na(df$X)) || any(is.na(df$Y))) {
    warning("Some coordinates could not be extracted from Parent column")
    df$attn_class_extended <- df$attn_class  # fallback
    return(df)
  }
  
  # Get all coordinates where attn_class == 1
  attention_coords <- df[df$attn_class == 1, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE]
  
  # If no attention squares, all extended values are 0
  if (nrow(attention_coords) == 0) {
    df$attn_class_extended <- 0
    return(df)
  }
  
  # Create all possible neighbor coordinates for attention squares
  neighbors <- data.frame()
  
  for (i in -1:1) {
    for (j in -1:1) {
      neighbor_coords <- data.frame(
        X = attention_coords$X + i * tile_size,
        Y = attention_coords$Y + j * tile_size
      )
      neighbors <- rbind(neighbors, neighbor_coords)
    }
  }
  
  # Remove duplicates and add extended attention flag
  neighbors <- unique(neighbors)
  neighbors$attn_class_extended <- 1
  
  # Initialize the extended column to 0
  df$attn_class_extended <- 0
  
  # Update values for coordinates that match neighbors
  matches <- paste(df$X, df$Y) %in% paste(neighbors$X, neighbors$Y)
  df$attn_class_extended[matches] <- 1
  df <- df %>%
    select(-X,-Y)
  return(df)
}

# Apply the function
region_level$attn_class <- ifelse(region_level$attention_score < 0.5, 0, 1)

region_level <- region_level %>%
  group_split(Image, .keep = TRUE) %>%
  future_map_dfr(~attn_extend_neighbour(.x))


region_level <- region_level %>%
  relocate(c("attn_class","attn_class_extended"),.before = Parent)%>%
    mutate(across(1:9, as.factor))

region_level <- region_level %>%
  select(-Class,-wsi,-flow, -progression, -pred, -dataset, 
                            -attn_class, -attn_class_extended,-Centroid.X.µm, -Centroid.Y.µm,-attention_score) %>%
  group_split(Image)%>%
  future_map_dfr(~ .x %>% 
                   group_by(Image, Parent)%>%
                   summarise(across(everything(), sum, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop'),
                 .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE))


region_level <- region_level %>%

  distinct()%>%
  left_join(x=region_level, by= c("Image", "Parent"))

region_level <- region_level%>%

  separate(Parent_, into = c("X", "Y"), sep = "_", convert = TRUE)

saveRDS(region_level, file.path(spatial_folder, "tabular/merged/","region_level_processed_250808.RDS"))
```

```{r}
get_new_xy <- function(df, tile_size = 112) {

  new_tile_size <- tile_size * 2
  
  df$x <- as.numeric(sub("_.*", "", df$Parent))
  df$y <- as.numeric(sub(".*_", "", df$Parent))
  
  min_x <- min(df$x)
  max_x <- max(df$x)
  min_y <- min(df$y)
  max_y <- max(df$y)
  
  new_x_coords <- seq(min_x, max_x, by = new_tile_size)
  new_y_coords <- seq(min_y, max_y, by = new_tile_size)
  
  
  df$new_x <- new_x_coords[findInterval(df$x, new_x_coords)]
  df$new_y <- new_y_coords[findInterval(df$y, new_y_coords)]
  return(df)
}

expand_tiles <- function(df){
  # print(df$Parent[1])
  df <- get_new_xy(df)
  new_df <- df %>%
    group_by(across(c(1:6,new_x, new_y))) %>%
    summarise(
      attention_score = max(attention_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      across(starts_with(c("Num.", "Area")), sum, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Parent = paste0(new_x, "_", new_y)) %>%
    select(-new_x, -new_y) 
  return(new_df)
}
```

```{r neigbour morisita}

find_neighboring_regions <- function(df, tile_size=112) {
  filtered_df <- df%>%
  filter(attention_score >= 0.5 )
  
  x = filtered_df$Centroid.X.px
  y = filtered_df$Centroid.Y.px
  
  neighbors <- data.frame(Centroid.X.px = numeric(), Centroid.Y.px = numeric())


  for (i in -1:1) {
    for (j in -1:1) {
      # if (i == 0 && j == 0) {
      #   next
      # }

      x_neighbor <- x + i * tile_size
      y_neighbor <- y + j * tile_size

      neighbor <- data.frame(Centroid.X.px = x_neighbor, Centroid.Y.px = y_neighbor)

      neighbors <- rbind(neighbors, neighbor)
    }
  }
  neighbors <- distinct(neighbors)
  neighbors$neighbor_attn <- 1
  df <- left_join(df, neighbors, by = c("Centroid.X.px", "Centroid.Y.px")) %>%
  mutate(neighbor_attn = if_else(is.na(neighbor_attn), 0, neighbor_attn))


  return(df)
}


find_and_summarize_neighboring_regions <- function(df, tile_size = 112) {
  # Filter the dataframe based on attention_score
  filtered_df <- df %>%
    filter(attention_score < 0.5 & neighbor_attn == 0)
  
  # Generate all neighbor offsets for a 3x3 grid (including self)
  neighbor_offsets <- expand.grid(i = -1:1, j = -1:1) %>%
    mutate(neighbor_dx = i * tile_size, neighbor_dy = j * tile_size) %>%
    select(neighbor_dx, neighbor_dy)

  # Join filtered_df with neighbor_offsets to generate all neighbors for each region
  neighbors <- filtered_df %>%
    crossing(neighbor_offsets) %>%
    mutate(
      Neighbor.X.px = Centroid.X.px + neighbor_dx,
      Neighbor.Y.px = Centroid.Y.px + neighbor_dy
    ) %>%
    select(Image, Neighbor.X.px, Neighbor.Y.px)
  
  # Fetch remaining columns from the main dataframe using a join to complete neighbor information
  neighbor_data <- neighbors %>%
    left_join(filtered_df, by = c("Image" = "Image", "Neighbor.X.px" = "Centroid.X.px", "Neighbor.Y.px" = "Centroid.Y.px")) %>%
    filter(neighbor_attn == 0)

  # Summarize neighboring regions by image
  summarized_df <- neighbor_data %>%
    group_by(Image) %>%
    summarise(across(starts_with("Num."), sum, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    left_join(df %>% select(Image, flow, pred, progression), by = "Image")
  
  summarized_df$Image <- as.factor(summarized_df$Image)
  df$Num.Lymphocyte.Plasma <- df$Num.Lymphocyte + df$Num.Plasma

  summarized_df <- df %>%
    group_by(Image, flow, pred,progression) %>%
    filter(Num.Epithelial > 0) %>%
    filter(Num.Plasma > 0 | Num.Lymphocyte > 0) %>%
    summarise(
      Morisita_lymph = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Lymphocyte), method = "morisita"),
      Morisita_detection = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Detections), method = "morisita"),
      Morisita_plasma = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Plasma), method = "morisita"),
      Morisita_lymph_plasma = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Lymphocyte.Plasma), method = "morisita"),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )

  return(summarized_df)
}
```

```{r plot_function}
plot_function <- function(df, lastname = NULL, aneuploid_filter = NULL , collumn = "Morisita_lymph"){
  if (!is.null(lastname)){
    df <- df %>%
  filter(endsWith(as.character(Image), lastname)) #"ROI0.tif"
  }
  
  if (!is.null(aneuploid_filter)){
    df <- df %>%
  filter(!!sym(aneuploid_filter) == 1) #"ROI0.tif"
  } else {
    aneuploid_filter <- "whole dataset"
  }
  
  plot <-df%>%
    drop_na(progression)%>%
ggplot( aes(x = progression, y = !!sym(collumn), fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +  # Use trim = FALSE to show the full distribution
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, color = "black", size = 0.5, aes(group = progression)) +  # Add median bar
  labs(x = "Progression", y = "Morisita Index", fill = "Progression") +
  theme_minimal() +
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", label = "p.signif",  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5)) +  # Add p-value from +
  ggtitle(paste(aneuploid_filter, collumn,lastname, sep= " "))
print(plot)
}
```

```{r diploid neigbour morisita}

diploid_find_and_summarize_neighboring_regions <- function(df, tile_size = 112) {
  # Filter the dataframe based on attention_score
  filtered_df <- df %>%
    filter(attention_score < 0.5 & neighbor_attn == 0)
  
  # Generate all neighbor offsets for a 3x3 grid (including self)
  neighbor_offsets <- expand.grid(i = -1:1, j = -1:1) %>%
    mutate(neighbor_dx = i * tile_size, neighbor_dy = j * tile_size) %>%
    select(neighbor_dx, neighbor_dy)

  # Join filtered_df with neighbor_offsets to generate all neighbors for each region
  neighbors <- filtered_df %>%
    crossing(neighbor_offsets) %>%
    mutate(
      Neighbor.X.px = Centroid.X.px + neighbor_dx,
      Neighbor.Y.px = Centroid.Y.px + neighbor_dy
    ) %>%
    select(Image, Neighbor.X.px, Neighbor.Y.px)
  
  # Fetch remaining columns from the main dataframe using a join to complete neighbor information
  neighbor_data <- neighbors %>%
    left_join(filtered_df, by = c("Image" = "Image", "Neighbor.X.px" = "Centroid.X.px", "Neighbor.Y.px" = "Centroid.Y.px")) %>%
    filter(neighbor_attn == 0)

  # Summarize neighboring regions by image
  summarized_df <- neighbor_data %>%
    group_by(Image) %>%
    summarise(across(starts_with("Num."), sum, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    left_join(df %>% select(Image, flow, pred, progression), by = "Image")
  
  # Calculate Morisita indices (adjusted to new summarized_df)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(Num.Lymphocyte.Plasma = Num.Lymphocyte + Num.Plasma)
  
  morisita_df <- df %>%
    group_by(Image, flow, pred, progression) %>%
    filter(Num.Epithelial > 0) %>%
    filter(Num.Plasma > 0 | Num.Lymphocyte > 0) %>%
    summarise(
      diploid_Morisita_lymph = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Lymphocyte), method = "morisita"),
      diploid_Morisita_detection = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Detections), method = "morisita"),
      diploid_Morisita_plasma = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Plasma), method = "morisita"),
      diploid_Morisita_lymph_plasma = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Lymphocyte.Plasma), method = "morisita"),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )

  return(morisita_df)
}



```
